2609.00068.title: Life Operators: a self-evolving framework for multiscale life modelling
2609.00068.paper_summary: Medical AI is moving beyond recognition towards clinical dialogue and longitudinal prediction. Yet a central question remains: how would a patient's state change under intervention? Statistical models learn future observations, whereas mechanistic models describe selected processes. Neither provides a common framework for representing patient state, coupling scales or revising failed assumptions. We propose Life Operators: task-bounded mappings that define three scientific roles. Perception operators infer task-relevant biological states from multimodal observations, Evolution operators propagate these states under natural or intervention-conditioned dynamics, and Generation operators map them to measurable signals. Each role may be realised by equations, statistical models, neural networks or hybrids. Bridge operators connect components with different variables, scales and time steps. Selected operators and bridges form task-specific Operator Graphs containing the smallest set of states and mechanisms sufficient for a declared claim. This modular structure also makes scientific revision localisable. An AI co-scientist may propose changes to states, operators, bridges or graph structure, while independent evidence determines which variants are retained, restricted or retired. Over time, validated components could accumulate into broader multiscale models of the human body and provide a computational foundation for medical artificial superintelligence.
2609.00068.paper_summary_zh: 醫療人工智慧正從識別轉向臨床對話和長期預測。<lb/>然而，一個核心問題仍然存在：在介入下，病人的狀態會如何改變？<lb/>統計模型學習未來的觀察，而機制模型描述選定的過程。<lb/>兩者都未提供一個共同的框架來表示病人狀態、耦合尺度或修正失敗的假設。<lb/>我們提出生命運算符：定義三個科學角色的任務界定映射。<lb/>感知運算符從多模態觀察中推斷與任務相關的生物狀態，<lb/>演化運算符在自然或介入條件下傳播這些狀態，<lb/>而生成運算符將它們映射到可測量的信號。<lb/>每個角色可以通過方程、統計模型、神經網絡或混合體來實現。<lb/>橋接運算符連接具有不同變量、尺度和時間步長的組件。<lb/>選定的運算符和橋接形成特定任務的運算符圖，包含足以支持所聲明主張的最小狀態和機制集。<lb/>這種模組化結構也使科學修訂可定位。<lb/>人工智慧共同科學家可以提出對狀態、運算符、橋接或圖結構的變更，<lb/>而獨立證據則決定哪些變體被保留、限制或淘汰。<lb/>隨著時間的推移，經過驗證的組件可以累積成更廣泛的人體多尺度模型，並為醫療人工超智慧提供計算基礎。
